subject: Handoff complete: Gen7 Shizuku/setup/wallpaper truth audit
body: Bounded lane complete against exact current main db0810e5. SOURCE-confirmed: (1) ShizukuBridge publishes State.Ready after permission while DuoShellService may still be unbound, creating human-readable Ready vs strict ready=false split-brain; (2) PersistentRuntimeService unconditionally says 'Duo Open is ready'; (3) setup/onboarding has no single aggregate state machine; (4) Duo wallpaper picker is picker-only and verification is not proof of every Fold7 panel/home/lock assignment; (5) Samsung FoldInteractive precise-angle prerequisite and Duo wallpaper mode are distinct concepts not cleanly separated in UX; (6) SetupGuide 'has no network access' is inaccurate because INTERNET is requested and configured diagnostic HTTPS upload exists. Current source DOES implement Open Shizuku launch + web fallback, so the older field claim that it is inert must stay a physical regression test, not be promoted as current-source fact. Runtime privileged gating itself correctly requires ShizukuBridge.ready and precise-angle authority correctly uses fresh callbacks rather than WallpaperManager metadata. Deterministic proposed state model tests 9/9 PASS. GitHub workflow runs/statuses for current HEAD returned empty; Android CI NOT_EVIDENCED. Physical Fold7 NOT_RUN. Recommended Manager disposition: READY_FOR_PRIMARY for setup-state/service-pack patch design; NEEDS_PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE for runtime/field claims.
